svg.text: How the BDBV nowcast and forecast model works
One model links how the outbreak spreads with how cases reach the published data
Each of 117 health zones has its own
epidemic, linked by travel between zones
Spread (R) changes week to week; zones
Not every case is in the data yet.
How long it takes differs by province
and changes as backlogs build and clear
Each week's count grows in later releases;
that growth shows how fast reporting is
Fills in recent weeks and projects
the next 3–4 weeks, for every zone,
All four parts are estimated at once in a Bayesian model (Stan). Uncertainty about how fast the outbreak is
spreading and about how complete the latest data are both carry through to the forecast ranges.
